Chapter 498 - 498 Twins; Change!

Chapter 498 - 498 Twins; Change!

498 Twins; Change!

The bell of the door scared Xia Bing and Xia Xue, who had just raised their heads. They hurriedly lowered their heads. Their pretty faces were even more flushed.

After a while, they slowly got up and walked toward the door.

The door slowly opened, and a tall and handsome figure immediately appeared in their field of vision.

It was Lin Fan!

Their eyes met.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue were slightly stunned. Their beautiful eyes were like gemstones, emitting an incomparably gorgeous light.

Perhaps it was because they felt the other party’s hot breath, but in the next moment…

Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s faces immediately turned red like ripe tomatoes.

They hurriedly lowered their heads.

Their hearts were beating like drums.

Lin Fan looked at their cute faces and could not help but laugh. “Can I come in?”

Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s hearts beat even more violently.

They seemed to have used up all their strength before they could gently nod their little heads.

Lin Fan did not stand on ceremony and walked in.

Then, Xia Bing and Xia Xue hurriedly closed the door.

Just as they closed the door, a beautiful figure appeared.

It was Liu Qianqian.

Originally, Liu Qianqian wanted to talk to Xia Bing and Xia Xue.

After all, they were both women, and it was their first time going abroad.

However, when her fingers were about to touch the doorbell, she slowly stopped and muttered, “Did someone come here just now?”

She thought for a moment, then withdrew her hand and returned to her room.

…

At this moment, in the presidential suite.

Lin Fan walked up to the tall, bright window and looked at the dazzling Eiffel Tower in the distance. “I’ve long heard of the name of the Eiffel Tower. It looks pretty good with the night view.”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue looked out of the window. Their two pairs of beautiful eyes seemed to be reflected by the light of the Eiffel Tower, and they became extremely bright.

At this moment, a gust of cool wind swept over from afar, bringing with it the fragrance of flowers.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue could not help but sneeze.

When Lin Fan heard this, he slowly closed the window and turned to look at Xia Bing and Xia Xue.

Perhaps it was because the windows were closed, but the air in the room suddenly became a little stuffy.

Perhaps, Lin Fan’s gaze was too fiery…

Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s pretty faces gradually became redder.

Lin Fan could not help but use his Eyes of Truth to look at the two of them.

[Appearance: 95]

[Favorability: 99]

[Appearance: 95]

“You guys…”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue seemed to have thought of something. They hurriedly took out a bottle of energy drink each and handed them to Lin Fan.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan smiled and asked, “Where did you guys buy these?”

After all, this was Barney, not Hua Nation.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue said in unison, “O-Outside.”

Lin Fan could not help but think back to the time when the two of them had gone out hurriedly after their meal.

They had probably gone out to buy the energy drinks.

Lin Fan took the two bottles and drank a mouthful of each.

Seeing this…

A sweet smile immediately appeared on Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s pretty faces.

Lin Fan looked at their smiles and could not help but think back to how they insisted on waiting at the basketball court every day.

He recalled how they wanted to chat with him but did not dare to send him a message. Therefore, they wrote messages in the chat box every day…

He thought of how happy they looked as if they had eaten honey whenever he praised them.

He could not help but raise his arm and gently stroke Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s hair. He slowly moved his head toward their beautiful faces.

In an instant, the redness on their faces quickly spread to their ears, necks, arms, and legs… It continued to spread.

Soon, Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s bodies were completely red.

Then, they fell straight onto the sofa.

Lin Fan shouted, “Xia Bing! Xia Xue!”

However, no matter how he shouted, the two of them did not respond.

Lin Fan hurriedly placed his hands on Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s hands.

He could only feel that the two people’s pulses were beating at a speed of several times per second.

Sun Simiao, the King of Medicine, had saved thousands of people in his life!

It could be said that Lin Fan had a wealth of medical experience.

Lin Fan had Sun Simiao’s Medical Experience, but after taking Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s pulse, he could not help but be surprised.

Without any hesitation, he spent 20 million yuan to exchange for two bottles of Medical Water from the system and quickly poured them into their mouths.

After the Medical Water was consumed, the fiery red color on Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s bodies slowly faded, and their pulses gradually returned to normal.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan heaved a sigh of relief.

In the past, patients would wake up very quickly after drinking a bottle of Medical Water.

However, this time, Xia Bing and Xia Xue showed no signs of opening their eyes.

Lin Fan prepared to carry them to bed to rest.

However, when he picked up Xia Bing, who was the closest to him, her entire body turned red again.

Lin Fan had no choice but to quickly put her down. He spent another ten million yuan to exchange for a bottle of Medical Water and poured it into Xia Bing’s mouth.

Only then did Xia Bing’s body return to normal.

Lin Fan understood that he could not hug them anymore.

Hence, he took out a blanket and covered the two of them.

In order to prevent any accidents, Lin Fan did not leave. He sat on another soft sofa and played with his phone.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

When a few birds flew past outside, the eyelashes of Xia Bing and Xia Xue, who were asleep, fluttered.

Then, the two of them slowly opened their eyes.

They looked at the spacious living room and were at a loss for what to do.

However, when Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s gazes landed on Lin Fan, they immediately recalled the scene of Lin Fan’s head coming close. Their faces instantly turned red.

Lin Fan smiled. “You’re awake?”

Last night, Lin Fan did not sleep.

However, with his extraordinary physique, he was not affected at all. He was still in high spirits.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue buried their heads and nodded hard. They said softly, “Yes, yes.”

Lin Fan looked at their shy faces.

He knew that if he stayed here, they would never be able to adapt.

“Then go wash up first. We’ll go downstairs for breakfast later.”

After saying that, he walked out.

Just as Lin Fan opened the door, a beautiful figure appeared at the door.

It was Liu Qianqian.
